clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineer Kadrell is a stalwart dwarven sentry stationed across from the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar. Serving as a crucial liaison within the Loch Modan Mountaineers, he coordinates reconnaissance, supply deliveries, and border defense across the region.

Standing watch in the bustling settlement of Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell acts as an anchor for dwarven defenses throughout Loch Modan. While outposts on the valley's fringes face relentless pressure from troggs, gnolls, and native beasts, Kadrell remains at the center of town to organize reinforcements, relay orders, and assess incoming field reports from wandering scouts.

Kadrell's duties frequently involve maintaining contact between Thelsamar and remote forward positions. Whether coordinating with Mountaineer Stormpike or sending adventurers to report to sentries like Mountaineer Rockgar, Kadrell ensures that the isolated outposts guarding the mountain passes receive vital supplies, reinforcements, and defensive intelligence.
